products.title: Sofa - Juliette - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Christophe Delcourt’s Juliette sofa immediately asserts itself with its clean design and extreme, almost cubist modularity. A modular, double-sided soft leather sofa that is extremely versatile and always ready to reinvent itself thanks to its low backrest. An upholstered piece that becomes an individually usable element, a seat for conversation, a chaise longue filled with cushions, a comfortable ottoman... as if it needed a pretext to show itself from every angle. Above all, Juliette is an outstanding piece with details that deserve to be observed and described one by one. The result of precise and meticulous work, this modular sofa is a beautiful tribute to creativity and savoir faire.

products.title: Sofa - Budapest Soft- By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Budapest Soft is a cosy leather sofa that stands out for its clean and simple design, emblematic of the elegant comfort that characterises Baxter upholstered furniture. Paola Navone designs a model with majestic dimensions that immediately becomes the focal point of the living room. The seat is wide and enveloping, made even more welcoming by the possibility of adding big soft cushions in which to sink. The details make the difference: the raw-edge stitching, the soft leather and the ability to compose your preferred shape make Budapest Soft a sofa that is as exclusive as it is versatile, a model that catches the eye and tempts you to indulge in a moment of carefree relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Donovan Square
products.description_html: Sofa upholstered in leather or fabric, frame in wood with elastic spring belts. Back and armrests in polyether and padded in feather. Seat cushions padded in polyurethane foam with different densities, Memory Foam® and feather sewed to the external upholstery; loose cushions padded in feather. The sofas are embraced by an external structure in plywood covered in fabric (Gand, Faber or Vermeer) with cannetté quilted decoration. Cylindrical metal feet with Visionnaire logo in relief. Available with increased depth by means of an extension of the rear base, which can fit small tables in marble with leather piping and/or small book shelves in leather with glass shelf. Modular version includes central, corner and lateral elements. Metal parts can be lacquered with chrome, gold, champagne, Siena, gunmetal grey or black nickel finish.

products.title: Sofa - F-Stripes
products.description_html: Representing Italian savoir-faire, the F-Stripes sofa subtly reveals iconic elements of Fendi's artisanal tradition. Its sleek, discreet shape is undoubtedly captivating; by looking closer one can appreciate all its distinctive details: the slender, tapering legs, its vertical elements finished with FF logo details and leather side bands inspired by Fendi's Selleria workmanship. Its neutral tones and logoed cushions create a welcoming atmosphere in the living area.

products.title: Sofa - Five
products.description_html: A seamless dialogue between architecture and design, the Five sofa by Marcel Wanders is a harmoniously-balanced of seating and storage solution. Each padded modular seating unit is upholstered in a choice of fabric or leather, creating an elegant contrast of solids and voids with the marble side table and its push-pull drawer in varnished wood. A supremely versatile item of furniture with a host of configurations, it is designed to foster convivial living.

products.title: Sofa - Parsifal Round
products.description_html: With its inviting form, the Parsifal round sofa is destined to become an irresistible magnet in your home as the place to live, socialise or simply relax. The semi-circular shape embraces the space like an amphitheatre, while the padded frame with armrests in Pequin fabric creates a striking effect. The padding is designed to deliver exceptional comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Sohoft
products.description_html: Full shapes and oversized volumes characterise the Sohoft sofa, featuring a tactile combination of soft padded elements. Calibrated proportions and iconic Fendi details are the defining traits of a new interrelation between fashion and luxury design. The variety of modules offers interesting style opportunities with a distinctly contemporary touch, ranging from vis-à-vis seating to more articulated and expansive solutions.

products.title: Sofa - Taiko
products.description_html: The Taiko sofa, designed by Piero Lissoni, stands out for its generous volumes and deep, comfortable seating. Exuding personality, the piece has a linear, lightweight expression, underpinned by a modular design that will easily fit multiple landscapes. Refined finishing touches nod to Fendi's iconic leather craftsmanship – notice the interlaced micro-piping and FF motifs. Customisable cushions complete the design, giving life to a personal and luxurious concept of contemporary living.
